description: Use this when you need to know what a wallet holds and what it is worth. One address in, portfolio out: for a 0x address, native coin plus ~70 curated major tokens (stablecoins, WETH/WBTC/cbBTC, LSTs, top DeFi and meme tokens) across Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, OP Mainnet, Polygon and BNB Chain in parallel; for a Solana address, SOL plus every SPL / Token-2022 balance. USD value per holding, per-chain totals and a grand total (DefiLlama prices), sorted by value. Spam-free on EVM; a failing chain is reported in sources, never fails the call. Returns JSON with: ok, data, sources, fetched_at, cache_age_s. Price: $0.015 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/wallet-portfolio

address.description: EVM address (0x...) or Solana wallet address (base58)

chains.description: EVM only: comma-separated subset of eth,base,arbitrum,optimism,polygon,bsc (default all 6)

min_usd.description: hide holdings worth less than this (default 0.01)

name: wallet_portfolio
title: Wallet Portfolio
